documents_expected.why: who can apply, match, bids, equipment and land rules

eligibility.rule: Anyone: individuals, private organisations and public entities
eligibility.quote: There are no restrictions on applicants or project sponsors as long as the project falls within the eligibility criteria. Individuals, private organizations, and public entities may apply.

eligibility.rule: For-profits must show public benefit, not private benefit
eligibility.quote: For-profit organizations must demonstrate that the project results in public benefit and does not pay for private benefits.

eligibility.rule: No support to regulatory programmes or legally mandated actions (except remediation)
eligibility.quote: Does your project provide direct assistance to regulatory programs? (04.001.01)
alt_quotes: Does your project implement actions mandated by regulations, excluding remediation? (04.001.01)

eligibility.rule: Fits the Board's categories: habitat, water, waste, air or soil
eligibility.quote: Does this project make a real contribution to achieving the Board's environmental categories? (04.004)

eligibility.rule: Financially and technically feasible, with a sourced budget
eligibility.quote: Each applicant shall submit a project budget identifying the nature and amount of each source of funds to be used for the project

eligibility.rule: No costs before the contract is signed
eligibility.quote: The Trust does not reimburse costs incurred before a grant contract is signed by all required parties.

documents.item: Online application answering the eligibility and scoring questions
documents.quote: Applications need to be submitted through our online grant application portal

documents.item: Project budget with funding sources and receipt and spending schedules
documents.quote: Each applicant shall submit a project budget identifying the nature and amount of each source of funds to be used for the project; a schedule indicating when such funds will be received; and a schedule indicating when the funds available will be expended for project purposes.

documents.item: Government applicants: their bidding policy, if they use their own
documents.quote: the grantee must submit a copy of its bidding policy to the Trust

effort.step: Sign the grant contract before starting; then claim reimbursements
effort.quote: The project cannot begin until all required parties have signed. Grants are awarded on a reimbursement basis

co_finance_required.quote: A match is not required in any amount or percentage.

after_award.quote: Quarterly Reports. The Sponsor agrees to file such statements and reports according to the following schedule

notes: Annual cycle; the next deadline on the calendar is 7 September 2027 (the 2026 one has passed). No minimum or maximum award; up to three years per application. Match is scored (5% to 99% of project cost) but not required. Two bids are needed for purchases of $1,000 or more. Land bought must be held in perpetuity and stay on the tax roll.
